items.question: When is my report ready?
items.answer: After the event, in {{brand.stores.hostAppName}}. Open the event to see who came, who was new, what you sold and what guests said.

items.question: Do I need a Razorpay account?
items.answer: To sell tickets, yes, and we’ll help you set it up. Razorpay’s KYC check usually takes 1 to 2 working days. Free events don’t need one.

items.question: When do I get my money?
items.answer: By default, guests pay into your Razorpay account, and Razorpay sends it to your bank on its usual schedule for your account. {{brand.name}} doesn’t hold it.

items.question: How does {{brand.name}} charge me?
items.answer: One bill a month: 5% of ticket sales, memberships and form fees, net of refunds, never more than ₹10,000 a month. Nothing during your trial.

items.question: Can I export my numbers?
items.answer: Yes. Each event’s report downloads its guest list, check-ins, bookings and payments as CSV files, and you can export your guest contacts any time.
